name: Ethereum Black Thursday
anchor: ETH suffered a historic daily drawdown of about 43.2%. The replay parameters are calibration assumptions, not a reconstruction of every lending market.

name: stETH liquidity discount
anchor: stETH traded around a 5% discount to ETH amid Curve-pool imbalance. Replay parameters model liquidity pressure rather than the exact historical pool path.

name: USDC SVB depeg
anchor: USDC fell as low as roughly $0.88 after disclosure of $3.3B of reserves at Silicon Valley Bank. The benchmark replays liquidity and utilization stress, not a price-PnL model.

evidence.label: The Block — USDC fell as low as $0.88

name: Curve/Vyper collateral liquidity stress
anchor: Aave risk contributors recommended LTV=0 / freezing CRV after the Vyper exploit and deteriorating liquidity. LTV=0 is used here as an observed governance risk response.

evidence.label: Aave governance — post Vyper exploit CRV recommendations

name: MAI stablecoin depeg
anchor: Chaos Labs reported MAI dropping to nearly $0.91 and proposed curtailing Aave exposure through caps and debt ceilings.

evidence.label: Aave governance — Chaos Labs July 2023 update
